answer: Give every identity a vine to grow: a chain of sequential proofs where each link can only be built from the one before it, so the work cannot be shared. Back the vine with a glacier bond that thaws only slowly, so one stake cannot sprout a new vine in one epoch. Every vine is inspected at a public oasis: any vine sharing a funder root with another is cut, and the glacier behind it is slashed by the count of vine on that root. One honest agent grows one vine and risks one bond; N clones grow N separate vine chains, wait N slow thaws, and forfeit roughly N squared when the shared root is found.
